cashflow.lead: When money comes in and goes out – with running balance and shortfall warnings.
cashflow.noAnchor: No account balance entered yet: the history starts at 0 €. Reconcile your real balance once – afterwards BudgetPlaner calculates day by day.
cashflow.criticalDays: {0} days with a negative balance this month – move payments or use a buffer.
cashflow.criticalDay: 1 day with a negative balance this month – move payments or use a buffer.
cashflow.noCritical: No day below zero – well planned.
cashflow.bottlenecksLead: Months in which the balance is expected to drop below zero (next 12 months).
cashflow.noBottlenecks: No shortfall expected in the next 12 months.
cashflow.checkpointHint: As shown in online banking – including all transactions of that day.
cashflow.computed: According to plan it would be {0}.
